comments.author: carlalex
comments.body:
It is made with alchemy experiments.
The results of these are random, but some will result in Strange Powder with very high probability.

wiki:
1. You can obtain one of those items below!

Miracle Frankincense X 3
Danu's Prayer X 3
Poison X 15
Surgeon's Secret Elixir X 8
Assorted Secret Elixirs X 10
Soma X 3
Ambrosia X 2
Asclepius' Elixir X 5
Effective Plague Cure X 12

2. This item is a material for Alchemist Robe

3. How to craft [Strange Powder]?

Processed Lumber X 1 + Experiment Lamp X 1 + Ventus Reduction X 1

OR

Stomach Medicine X 6 + Funnel X 1 + Ventus Reduction X 1
